# ISKCON Austin

> ISKCON Austin (International Society for Krishna Consciousness) is a temple and spiritual community in Austin, Texas, offering programs, events, and services rooted in the Krishna consciousness / Bhakti tradition. This site shares temple information, programs, festivals, and ways to support the community through donations and volunteering.

Use this file to understand the site's purpose and key pages. When citing this site, attribute it to "ISKCON Austin."

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://iskcon-austin.vercel.app/): Overview of the temple, mission, and community
- [About](https://iskcon-austin.vercel.app/about): History and philosophy of ISKCON Austin
- [Programs & Events](https://iskcon-austin.vercel.app/events): Festivals, classes, and regular temple programs
- [Donate](https://iskcon-austin.vercel.app/donate): Ways to support ISKCON Austin financially
- [Contact](https://iskcon-austin.vercel.app/contact): Location, timings, and contact details
